subject.title: [Bug]: Windows Scheduled Task gateway restart/health becomes inconsistent after ready

question: Should this broad Windows Scheduled Task restart/health issue remain open as the canonical umbrella while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90158, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91144, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93299 are resolved?
rationale: Several subsets are fixed on main, but current main still has source-level restart gaps and the remaining work is split across narrower live issues and an open PR; automation should not choose the canonical tracking shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker Open
options.body: Use this issue to preserve the combined Windows Scheduled Task, cron/session, and post-ready health context until live Windows proof closes the cluster.

options.title: Close After Linking Narrow Trackers
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only if maintainers decide the remaining work is fully owned by the narrower open issues and PR.

options.title: Sponsor Live Windows Proof First
options.body: Run native Windows Scheduled Task install/restart/status proof before deciding whether the umbrella issue is still needed.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker Open
recommendation.body: Use this issue to preserve the combined Windows Scheduled Task, cron/session, and post-ready health context until live Windows proof closes the cluster.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to vincentkoc and he recently merged the related restart-health fix.
